title: Deposit
description: A small mod that adds a few Item Deposit commands for servers.
body:
A short list of commands meant to be used for server events. This mod is not server-side, however, and requires all players to download seperatly in order to work.

List of Commands

Player:

/deposit - Will deposit the item(s) currently in the players main hand.
/depositcheck - Will show how many items have been deposited total.

Admin:

/resetall - Will reset the current week (or "season") to 0, mainly for testing purposes.
/setdeposit - Will set the required item (or basically the item that players can deposit) to whatever item is in the admins main hand.
